note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official PSN list, verbatim. Every guide is written in our own words. A step that comes from the official description rather than a played verification says so honestly.

sources.title: GTA 6 Trophies: All 55 Trophies and Xbox Achievements
GTA 6 Side Activities: Things to Do in Leonida
GTA 6 Trophy List: How to Unlock All Trophies and Achievements

phases.title: Chapters 1–2 — story + the one missable
phases.blurb: Play the story. Meditate on the balcony in Chapter 1 before it ends — the only trophy any source calls possibly missable.

phases.title: Chapters 3–4 — story + partner moments
phases.blurb: Finish the story missions. Grab the partner trophies while you and your partner are together.

phases.title: Finale — free roam opens
phases.blurb: Complete the final mission. Free roam carries on after the story, so almost everything can wait until now.

phases.title: Strangers & side strands
phases.blurb: Eight stranger strands, including the final missions for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone.

phases.title: Collectibles sweep
phases.blurb: Meditations, card sets, WAiNK spots, vehicles, areas and garages — the long checklist.

phases.title: Activities & races
phases.blurb: All nine activity types, drone races, road races, fishing, arcade and the shooting range.

phases.title: Heists, combat & gangs
phases.blurb: Bank vaults, armored trucks, jewelry, gang operations and Combat Focus.

phases.title: Money, property & vehicles
phases.blurb: Launder marked bills, spend across shops, buy garages, register vehicles.

phases.title: Cleanup — stunts, challenges, platinum
phases.blurb: 250 stunts, 50 challenges, the unconfirmed hidden trophies, 100% completion, then the platinum.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. [1] [3]
Everything is single-player and one playthrough is enough; plan on around 200 hours, most of it the 100% checklist. [3] [5]
Keep cheats off the whole run — a cheat disables trophies and saving. [3]

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to the end. It cannot be missed. [3]
Story trophy: it unlocks naturally as you follow the Chapter 1 objectives. [3] [4]

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1. [3] [5]
Before the chapter ends, meditate on the balcony at Jason's house — the one step sources flag as possibly missable. [1] [7]

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 2. [3] [5]
The asterisks are in the official name itself, straight from PSN. [4]

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 3. [3] [5]
Side content you meet along the way can be done now or after the story — free roam continues. [3]

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 4. [3] [5]
There is no mission replay, so enjoy the set-pieces — but no chapter trophy itself can be missed. [3]

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
guide: Play the final mission through to the end. [3] [5]
After the credits, free roam carries on — every remaining trophy except the balcony meditation can still be earned. [3] [6]

trophies.name: Trust
guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. [3] [4]
Story mission trophies unlock as you play the chapters; none is flagged missable by any source. [3] [6]

trophies.name: Break the Bank
guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. [3] [4]
A story trophy — it comes from playing the mission, not from a side objective. [3]

trophies.name: Family Matters
guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. [3] [4]
No extra objective is attached to it in any guide we checked — finish the mission. [5] [6]

trophies.name: DWNFALL
guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. [3] [4]
Story trophy, unlocked by finishing the mission. [3] [5]

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. [3] [4]
While you are at the airport, note the VCIA trophy below — an unscheduled departure is a separate trophy. [4]

trophies.name: Snow Storm
guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. [3] [4]
The last named-mission trophy before the finale. [5]

trophies.name: A Long Road
guide: Work through the in-game 100% checklist (Map, then Progress) — it is the longest trophy in the game. [3] [7]
The checklist needs 15 of 18 meditations and 70 of 80 challenges, among other items. [1] [2]
It also needs all 42 shooting-range golds — the range work from The Shootist feeds straight into this. [1] [2]
Sources agree this is the hardest trophy; leave it until the story and side strands are done. [3] [5]
Check the Progress menu as you go — it shows exactly which checklist items are still open. [7]

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
guide: Build the count with near-misses, jumps and airtime while driving — stunts rack up across the whole game. [5] [7]
Track the total in the Progress menu; grind the last ones on long highway runs after the story. [7]
From the official description, not yet checked in-game: whether repeated stunts in one spot all count.

dispute.a: Any 250 stunts count, repeats included (the plain reading of the description).
dispute.b: 250 UNIQUE stunts are needed — KeenGamer's wording. [5]
dispute.call: Assume unique: vary the stunt and the spot, so the count holds under either reading.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
guide: Try one of each of the nine activity types: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball, arcade, a race and a stunt. [5] [7]
One try each is enough — no wins or medals are needed for this trophy. [5]
The shooting range and golf are the easiest to overlook; both are marked activities on the map. [7]

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
guide: Visit both ranges — Griffin Shooting Range and Rodgers Ranch — and work through their challenges. [2] [10]
42 gold medals are needed in total; each challenge has its own gold score. [2] [10]
Scores are timed, with bonuses for fast, accurate runs — speed matters as much as aim. [2] [10]
Ranges are easy to miss early on — the game does not direct you to them, so go deliberately. [10]
Range practice also raises your Focus meter, which makes Gunslinger's five-in-one-Combat-Focus ask easier. [10]

dispute.a: 12 Shooting Range challenges hold the 42 golds (PowerPyx guide pages). [2]
dispute.b: 14 challenges hold the same 42 golds (PowerPyx wiki summary). [2]
dispute.call: The gold count is agreed at 42 either way — chase golds, not the challenge count.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
guide: Win one Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. [5]
One win per location is enough — you do not need every race at a location. [5]
From the official description, not yet checked in-game: whether later locations only open as the story advances.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
guide: Win 20 different races — repeats of the same race do not add to the count. [5]
There are also 13 race-challenge gold medals, a separate goal for the 100% checklist. [2]
Spread the wins across race types so the count keeps moving. [7]

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
guide: Find Cal's fishing challenge and beat his catch. [5]
Fishing is one of the nine activity types, so this also feeds Master of None. [7]
From the official description, not yet checked in-game: where Cal's challenge is offered.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
guide: Play one arcade game through to its end. [5]
Any arcade machine counts, and it also ticks one of the nine activity types. [7]

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
guide: Follow Andy's mission strand to its final mission and complete it. [3] [5]
Stranger strands stay available in free roam after the story. [3] [6]

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
guide: Follow Kenton's mission strand to its final mission and complete it. [3] [5]
Each named stranger has their own final mission — Kenton's is separate from the others. [5]

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
guide: Follow Billy's mission strand to its final mission and complete it. [3] [5]
Stranger strands count toward the eight needed for Strangers & Freaks. [3]

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
guide: Complete eight full stranger mission strands across Leonida. [3] [5]
The five named finals (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) are five of the eight — find three more strangers. [5]
Strands stay open in free roam, so there is no rush during the story. [3]

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
guide: Follow Randy's mission strand to its final mission and complete it. [3] [5]
Stranger strands stay available in free roam after the story. [3] [6]

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
guide: Follow Tyrone's mission strand to its final mission and complete it. [3] [5]
Tyrone's final is the fifth named stranger finale in the list. [5]

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.lastChance: Before Chapter 1 ends — the balcony meditation at Jason's house may not be available later.
guide: First, in Chapter 1: meditate with Lucia at Jason's house — sources place a balcony meditation there and warn it may be unavailable after Chapter 1 ends. [3] [7]
Count meditations, not spots: 18 is the number PSN tracks, across 10 marked spots — some spots hold a second meditation. [2]
Work through the remaining spots after the balcony one, some done once per character. [2] [7]
The 100% checklist only needs 15 of the 18 meditations, but this trophy needs all 18 — keep going past 15. [1] [2]
Meditations sit in the phase-5 collectibles sweep — fold them into exploring Leonida rather than hunting them all in one run. [7]
Keep a manual save until the trophy pops; the balcony step is the one no source can confirm is repeatable. [1] [7]

dispute.a: 18 meditation SPOTS — the plain reading of the trophy description.
dispute.b: 10 spots holding 18 MEDITATIONS — PowerPyx's count, with some spots done twice. [2]
dispute.call: Count meditations, not spots: 18 is the number PSN tracks, and the balcony one is the only possibly missable step.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
guide: Take Bret's hunting strand and track the unique animal he names. [5]
Hunting is one of the nine activity types, so this also feeds Master of None. [7]
From the official description, not yet checked in-game: which animal is the unique one.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
guide: Collect cards across Leonida until three full sets are complete. [5]
Cards are a collectible sweep — pick them up as you explore rather than hunting them all at once. [7]
From the official description, not yet checked in-game: how many cards each set holds.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
guide: Use the WAiNK It interaction at 100 different locations. [5]
Fold it into exploration: WAiNK at each new area as you open the map for The Goodtime State. [7]
From the official description, not yet checked in-game: whether WAiNK spots are marked on the map.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
guide: Complete any 50 of the game's 80 challenges — eight categories of ten each. [2]
The 100% checklist needs 70 of 80, so keep going past 50 if you are chasing A Long Road. [2]
Check the Progress menu to see which categories are closest to done. [7]

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose it and escape. [5]
Do it while the story keeps you together — partner availability varies by chapter. [3]
From the official description, not yet checked in-game: whether partner free-roam stays available after the story.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
guide: With your partner, rob three shops in a row while keeping your wanted level the whole time. [5]
Pick three shops close together so the wanted level has no time to drop between robberies. [5]
From the official description, not yet checked in-game: the exact wanted level the run must hold.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
guide: Discover 100 different vehicles — drive or approach each new model you see. [5]
New districts and traffic variety fill the count fastest; check Progress to see what is missing. [7]
Registering ten of them to the Scooter Bros app is a separate trophy. [4]

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
guide: Trigger Combat Focus with at least five enemies in view, then down five before it ends. [5]
Pick a busy fight and save beforehand so you can retry the timing. [5]
Shooting-range practice raises your Focus meter, which makes the window easier to use. [10]

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.risk: Unconfirmed — treat as at-risk until a guide verifies the method.
guide: At Vice City International Airport, leave in a way no timetable lists — take an aircraft out yourself. [4]
Try it around the VCIA Takedown mission, when you are already at the airport. [3]
From the official description, not yet checked in-game: the exact departure that pops the trophy.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
guide: The description names Rhinos — tanks. Find one and deal with it on your own terms. [4]
High wanted levels bring heavy military response; that is the likeliest place to meet a Rhino. [5]
From the official description, not yet checked in-game: whether you must steal, destroy or simply survive one.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected — plan the entry, keep a low profile and leave clean. [5]
Save before you start so a detection is a retry, not a failed run. [5]
From the official description, not yet checked in-game: which jewelry stores qualify.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape after each one — the escape is part of the requirement. [5]
Space the jobs out and keep a getaway vehicle ready; a bust mid-run wastes the job. [5]
From the official description, not yet checked in-game: how many vaults the map holds in total.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
guide: Find an armored truck on the road, rob it and escape. [5]
Trucks run set routes — learn one route, hit it, then break line of sight fast. [5]
From the official description, not yet checked in-game: whether the truck must be stopped first.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
guide: Visit all 52 areas of Leonida until the map is fully explored. [5]
Explore as you play: most areas open naturally through the story and side strands. [7]
Check the map for unvisited corners and sweep them in free roam after the finale. [3]

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
guide: Rob one illegal operation for each of the nine gangs in Leonida. [5]
Track which gangs you have hit — one operation per gang is enough. [5]
From the official description, not yet checked in-game: where each gang's operations are marked.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.risk: Unconfirmed — treat as at-risk until a guide verifies the method.
guide: Go to Ocean Beach, find a spot with a view and enjoy a cocktail there. [4]
The title hints at the game's opening area — try it early, while the story is still around the beach. [4]
From the official description, not yet checked in-game: the exact bar or prompt that triggers it.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.risk: Unconfirmed — treat as at-risk until a guide verifies the method.
guide: Drive a vehicle into a showroom, then smash your way back out through the glass — the classic GTA move. [4]
Pick a showroom with a clear exit line so the escape is part of the same run. [5]
From the official description, not yet checked in-game: which showrooms count.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.risk: Unconfirmed — treat as at-risk until a guide verifies the method.
guide: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through — bowl a full game. [4]
Bowling may be one of the activity types, so it can also feed Master of None. [7]
From the official description, not yet checked in-game: whether a full game or one frame is enough.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.risk: Unconfirmed — the description names no method; sources list no verified unlock.
guide: The official description is a riddle — 'a partnership with mass appeal' — and no source we checked gives a verified method. [4] [6]
The likeliest reading is a partner moment that draws a crowd; watch for it during partner missions. [6]
We will not invent a method: this one stays unconfirmed until a guide verifies it.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
guide: PSN tracks a count toward 500 — make choices as you play and the counter climbs. [4]
Say yes to dialogue options, side decisions and branching moments rather than skipping past them. [5]
From the official description, not yet checked in-game: which kinds of choice feed the counter.

dispute.a: Every dialogue choice counts toward the 500.
dispute.b: Only story decisions count — dialogue alone will not reach 500.
dispute.call: Make every choice you are offered, story and dialogue alike, so the count climbs under either reading.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.risk: Unconfirmed — the description names no method; sources list no verified unlock.
guide: The official description is a riddle — 'second time's the charm' — and no source we checked gives a verified method. [4] [6]
The plain reading is succeeding at something on a second attempt after failing once. [6]
We will not invent a method: this one stays unconfirmed until a guide verifies it.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.risk: Unconfirmed — the description names no method; sources list no verified unlock.
guide: The official description is a riddle, and sources list this as an unconfirmed unlock method. [5] [6]
The name points at something strange — keep an eye out for odd events while exploring. [5]
We will not invent a method: this one stays unconfirmed until a guide verifies it.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
guide: Perform a melee drive-by — strike someone with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle. [5]
Sources note the precise method is still being confirmed, so expect the details to move. [5]
Try it on a slow pass with a clear target; the bowling name is a pun on knocking them down. [5]

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
guide: Launder $250,000 of marked bills through your contacts over the course of the game. [5]
Marked bills come from robberies — heist income feeds this total, so it grows with phase 7. [5]
Track the running total in the Progress menu. [7]

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — the total is cumulative across every shop type. [5]
Buy gear, clothes and vehicle upgrades as you go; the count climbs without a dedicated grind. [5]
Save the big purchases for late in the game, when cash is plentiful. [7]

trophies.name: Little Boxes
guide: Buy all eight garage properties across Leonida. [5]
Garages cost serious money — this is a late-game purchase, after the heist income lands. [5]
From the official description, not yet checked in-game: the price of each garage.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
guide: Register ten vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. [5]
Register the vehicles you discover for Whip It Good — the two trophies overlap neatly. [4]
From the official description, not yet checked in-game: whether registration costs anything per vehicle.
